_note: Routing policy: the INTENTS an agent/task can declare instead of a hard-coded model. Each intent is a hard-constraint problem — filter models by the ceilings/floor + provider allowlist, then optimize the objective. This is the ONE file you tune to change the cost/latency/accuracy posture of the whole crew. Override at ~/.pi-stack/routing/policy.json.

intents.name: max-accuracy
intents.about: One genuinely hard problem. Accuracy dominates; no cost ceiling.

intents.name: code
intents.about: Production code/design/docs. Best accuracy under a sane per-task cost cap.

intents.name: reasoning
intents.about: Structured reasoning + writing (PRDs, RFCs, analysis). Accuracy under a cost cap.

intents.name: review
intents.about: Adversarial second opinion. Provider allowlist EXCLUDES anthropic so review stays cross-vendor from the main model (different blind spots).

intents.name: breadth
intents.about: Cheap, fast parallel fan-out. Cheapest model clearing an accuracy floor + latency ceiling.

intents.name: verify
intents.about: Test/QA passes. Balanced cost/latency/accuracy under a tight cost cap.
